name: XVS-G1 switcher processor
notes: 4RU, 440 x 176 x 583 mm, 22 kg fully optioned. 44 primary inputs and 24 outputs with all XKS-G1110 boards (1.5G/3G/12G), two HD multiviewers standard. Ref in x2 with loop, ref out. GPI DB25 (16 out, 6 in); optional Tally/GPI DB25 x2 (32 out, 12 in); optional RS-422 x8 on 4 RJ45 via breakout. LAN 1/2 gigabit, built-in redundant PSU. Check: AC inlet count.

name: XVS-9000 switcher processor
notes: 15RU processor. Shown fully loaded in HD: 160 in, 80 out (4K: 80 in, 40 out). 5 M/E (split M/E doubles it). I/O comes from 12G-SDI and 100G IP option boards (XKS-S9112, XKS-C9111), so remove ports you do not fit. Ref in with loop, MVS LAN and UTL LAN. GPI out DB25 (4 relay, 4 open collector). Tally, GPI and RS-422 are on the separate MKS-X7700/X2700 interface units. Check: AC inlet count and SDI board standard (12G boards available).

name: XVS-8000 switcher processor
notes: 10RU processor. Shown fully loaded in HD: 160 in, 48 out plus 16 format-converter outputs (4K: 40 in, 12 out). 5 M/E (split M/E doubles it). I/O comes from 12G-SDI and 100G IP option boards (XKS-S9112, XKS-C9111), so remove ports you do not fit. Ref in with loop, MVS LAN and UTL LAN. Tally, GPI and RS-422 are on the separate MKS-X7700/X2700 interface units. Check: AC inlet count and SDI board standard (12G boards available).

name: XVS-7000 switcher processor
notes: 8RU processor. Shown fully loaded in HD: 112 in, 48 out plus 16 format-converter outputs (4K: 28 in, 12 out). 3 M/E (split M/E doubles it). I/O comes from 12G-SDI and 100G IP option boards (XKS-S9112, XKS-C9111), so remove ports you do not fit. Ref in with loop, MVS LAN and UTL LAN. Tally, GPI and RS-422 are on the separate MKS-X7700/X2700 interface units. Check: AC inlet count and SDI board standard (12G boards available).

name: XVS-6000 switcher processor
notes: 6RU processor. Shown fully loaded in HD: 64 in, 24 out plus 16 format-converter outputs (4K: 16 in, 6 out). 2 M/E (split M/E doubles it). I/O comes from 12G-SDI and 100G IP option boards (XKS-S9112, XKS-C9111), so remove ports you do not fit. Ref in with loop, MVS LAN and UTL LAN. Tally, GPI and RS-422 are on the separate MKS-X7700/X2700 interface units. Check: AC inlet count and SDI board standard (12G boards available).

name: HDCU-3500 camera control unit
notes: 3RU half-rack width CCU, 6.3 kg. UHD SDI A/B out and C/D I/O on 12G BNC (12G/6G need HZCU-UHD35), 4 SDI out, 4 SDI I/O and 4 return on 3G BNC, 2 prompter, ref loop, intercom/tally/IO D-sub 50, RCP/CNU 8-pin, trunk 12-pin, LAN-COM, network trunk, 2 XLR audio out, character/AES BNC. Check: whether LAN-COM and network trunk are RJ45.

name: HDCU-5500 camera control unit
notes: 3RU half-rack width CCU with the same rear I/O as HDCU-3500 plus options: HKCU-SFP50 ST 2110 IP interface, HKCU-SM50 single-mode fibre, HKCU-REC55 recording. Check: LAN connector types.

name: HDCU-5000 camera control unit
notes: Full 19 in rack-width CCU, 19.5 kg, 2 camera fibre connectors. Same SDI, prompter, ref, intercom and audio I/O as HDCU-3500. Check: rack height (not stated by Sony) and LAN connector types.

name: PWS-4500 multi-port server
notes: 4K/HD multi-port AV storage server, 22 kg, 480 W max, redundant power. 4 SDI encoder inputs and 8 decoder outputs (3G), 2 HD monitor outs, 4 input monitor outs, ref loop, TC in/out BNC, 8 remote ports on 4 RJ45, GPIO DB25, 2 x 1G network, optional SFP+ 10G, 2 x 10G share play. 12G needs PWSK-4508. Check: rack height (assumed 4RU) and AC inlet count.

name: PDW-F1600 XDCAM HD professional disc recorder
notes: Half-rack desktop deck, 210 x 132 x 396 mm (3RU high, half width), about 6.5 kg, AC 100-240 V or DC 12 V, 80 W. Rack mount needs a Sony half-rack mount kit (two decks side by side in 3RU). Full-feature XDCAM HD deck (MPEG HD 4:2:0 up to 35 Mb/s, DVCAM, IMX), jog/shuttle. Check: USB and i.LINK panel face.
layoutSource: Sony PDW-HD1500/F1600 Operation Manual, rear panel drawing

name: PDW-HD1500 XDCAM HD422 compact recording deck
source: Sony PDW-HD1500 specifications (pro.sony) and XDCAM HD422 catalogue
notes: Half-rack desktop deck, 210 x 132 x 396 mm (3RU high, half width), about 6.5 kg, AC 100-240 V or DC 12 V, 80 W. Rack mount needs a Sony half-rack mount kit (two decks side by side in 3RU). XDCAM HD422 50 Mb/s, up to 8 audio channels. Also has a REMOTE 4-pin (DC 12 V) port. Check: USB and i.LINK panel face.
layoutSource: Sony PDW-HD1500/F1600 Operation Manual, rear panel drawing

name: PDW-F1500 XDCAM HD compact deck
notes: Half-rack desktop deck, 210 x 132 x 396 mm (3RU high, half width), about 6.5 kg, AC 100-240 V or DC 12 V, 80 W. Rack mount needs a Sony half-rack mount kit (two decks side by side in 3RU). First-generation XDCAM HD half-rack deck (MPEG HD 4:2:0, 35/25/18 Mb/s), predecessor of the PDW-HD1500 and PDW-F1600. Check: connectors assumed the same as the PDW-F1600 (same chassis); Sony no longer publishes the F1500 sheet.

name: XDS-PD2000 XDCAM professional media station (disc + SxS + SSD)
notes: 424 x 132 x 460 mm (3RU, full width), 16 kg, AC 100-240 V, 210 W. Professional Disc drive, 2 SxS slots, internal SSD; XAVC, MPEG HD422, IMX, DVCAM. Check: which USB ports are on the front.

name: HDW-M2000P HDCAM studio VTR (multi-format playback)
source: Expandore HDW-M2000P specification page and HDW-M2000 operation manual
notes: 427 x 174 x 544 mm (194 mm with feet), 23 kg, AC 100-240 V, 220 W. Records HDCAM, plays Digital Betacam, Betacam SX, Betacam SP. Optional HKDW-102 adds SDTI in/out. Rack mount on slides. Check: rack height (4RU without feet) and the D-sub 9 video control port.

name: SRW-5800 HDCAM SR studio VTR
notes: About 427 x 218 x 544 mm (5RU), 30 kg, 380 W with all options. HDCAM SR 4:4:4 / 4:2:2 dual-link capable with input/output B option boards; HKSR-5001 adds format conversion and a second reference. Check: rack height with feet removed, AC voltage range outside Japan (source is the Japanese catalogue, AC 100 V).

name: DVW-A500P Digital Betacam studio VTR
notes: 427 x 237 x 520 mm, 35 kg, AC 90-265 V, 175 W. Digital Betacam record, plays analogue Betacam/SP (A500). DVW-500P is the same without analogue playback (33 kg). Same frame size as BVW studio VTRs. Check: rack height (237 mm includes feet; 6RU assumed, may fit 5RU on slides).
